name: conesEquivSieveCompatibleFamily
statement: (S.arrows.diagram.op ⋙ P).cones.obj E ≃ { x : FamilyOfElements (P ⋙ coyoneda.obj E) (S : Presieve X) // x.SieveCompatible } where toFun π

name: subsingleton_iff_isSeparatedFor
statement: (∀ c, Subsingleton (c ⟶ P.mapCone S.arrows.cocone.op)) ↔ ∀ E : Aᵒᵖ, IsSeparatedFor (P ⋙ coyoneda.obj E) S.arrows

name: isSheaf_iff_isSheaf'
statement: IsSheaf J P' ↔ IsSheaf' J P'

name: isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget
statement: A' ⥤ Type (max v₁ u₁)) [HasLimits A'] [PreservesLimits s] [s.ReflectsIsomorphisms] : IsSheaf J P' ↔ IsSheaf J (P' ⋙ s)
